description: Concrete story-room layout: map and camera to load plus five parallel slots describing which characters, variations, materials, animations and spawn tags to use.

ID.technical: FName row key in StoryRoomPlacementDataTables (DTM +0x850). Selected by Story_PickRoomPlacement and passed as FStudioPhaseRequest.Name5C / GameManager.StudioStoryRoomPlacementId_D18; MainMenuStory prepare resolves exactly this id to build the room.

Id_Map.simple: Map row used for the room's base level and lighting.
Id_Map.technical: FName (row +0x10). Story_GetRoomPlacementLevels resolves it through Status_FindMapRow with no None pre-check and appends Map.FileName plus LevelDesignName. MainMenuStory also resolves it into RoomMapRow for ApplyMapCharacterLighting. Exported values are SRM_10/20/30.

LevelDesignName.simple: Extra level-design package appended to the map levels.
LevelDesignName.technical: FName (row +0x18). Story_GetRoomPlacementLevels appends it after all Map.FileName entries, so the returned level list is Map.FileName followed by this single package.

CameraName.simple: Tag used to find the story-room camera actor.
CameraName.technical: FName (row +0x20). MainMenuStory's room setup calls GetAllActorsOfClassWithTag(AGameStoryRoomCamera, CameraName); the first match is used as the view target with a constrained aspect ratio. An empty match leaves the previous view target.

Id_Character.simple: Character ids placed in the room.
Id_Character.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x28, five exported slots). MainMenuStory iterates it to build RoomSpawnEntries; entries with None character id, VariationIndex -1 or None PlacementName are skipped. Each id is resolved in CharacterDataTables before spawning.

VariationIndex.simple: Index of the character variation to spawn.
VariationIndex.technical: TArray<int32> parallel to Id_Character. -1 disables a slot; otherwise it indexes Character.Id_CharacterVariation, whose id is resolved in CharacterVariationDataTables to get the character blueprint file to preload. Exported values are 0, 5, 10 and 12.

MaterialPattern.simple: Material pattern index applied to the spawned character.
MaterialPattern.technical: TArray<int32> parallel to Id_Character (exported values 0 and 1). Copied into FStoryRoomSpawnEntry and passed to Character->GetMaterialController()->SetMaterialPattern after spawning.

CharacterAnimation.simple: Idle animation asset name for each placed character.
CharacterAnimation.technical: TArray<FName> parallel to Id_Character. Added to the AnimMontage primary-asset loader names; after spawning, the loaded montage is installed via AnimInstance->SetAnimationAsset and played with PlayAnimationAsset using this name as the animation key.

PlacementName.simple: Actor tag of the spawn point for each character.
PlacementName.technical: TArray<FName> parallel to Id_Character. A None tag disables the slot; otherwise the spawned level actors are searched with ActorHasTag(PlacementName) and the matching actor's transform becomes the spawn transform (identity if no match). Also copied into the spawn entry itself.

notes: The five character arrays are strictly index-parallel; the consumer assumes equal lengths and uses None / -1 as slot sentinels (Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_MainMenuStory.cpp:529-563).
Row constructor is empty (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryRoomPlacement.cpp:3). 67 exported rows; no shards or locale variants found.
This table is reached only after StoryRoomCondition's weighted pick; the placement id is stored on the phase request before MainMenuStory builds the room.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Resolves a placement id into the map's level names plus LevelDesignName.
Prepare state resolves the incoming placement id and its Map row.
Builds spawn entries and preload lists from the five parallel character arrays.
Spawns characters with the loaded animation/material/placement settings.
Finds and locks onto the tagged story-room camera.
